assertion_audit: tests/test_route_before_queue.py:301 compares the queued pointer's stored model with the literal astra supplied at dispatch; it fails if queueing drops or changes the stored selection, though it alone would not catch launch-time drift.
tests/test_route_before_queue.py:304 fails if admission does not launch the released request, and line 306 fails if it launches on local.

tests/test_route_before_queue.py:307-308 compare the launched model key and agent model against literal astra/model-astra while the lane default is sol/model-sol; restoring deterministic queued replay makes both fail, and the reverse-commit log records the model-key failure.

tests/test_route_before_queue.py:327 requires the actual fallback reason to contain the picker hard-ceiling verdict, and fails if that reason is lost or changed; the unchanged line 328 compares two fields derived from the same fallback map and is not counted as independent proof of its reason.

findings.text: blocking: _await_moved_launch passes an explicit destination as backend_override, but replay_pick stays true for an unedited picker request and plan_dispatch replaces that destination with picker_selection.backend (dispatch_plan.py:575-580); crew move can launch on the old lane while stamping the requested lane as the move.

item_verdicts.diff: The four commits 5d7cd24683ed7457ff2edc59eba92c5b85e78434 through 7ebe3eb93b4a8cca6aca6e8af5bc3673fa140666 add a nondefault-model test, replay stored picker routing, update the fragment, and change the fallback-reason assertion.
item_verdicts.done_when: resume-2-advice.txt requires an answered finding, exact base/head route gates, and a red reverse-commit control; repair-base.log and repair-head-final.log complete with 9 and 10 passes, and repair-negative-control.log fails the model assertion.
item_verdicts.goal: prompt.txt:30 requires picker routing through the queue; reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:237-276 now preserves a picked model on ordinary admission, but its replay also overrides an explicit queued move.
item_verdicts.manifest: manifest.md reports complete, names the four repair commits and the answered finding, and records complete zero-failure base/head route gates and the red reverse-commit log.
item_verdicts.write_paths: prompt.txt:70-75 and resume-2-advice.txt grant the fragment, queue_admission.py and test file; all three paths changed from e342eff679bd6e0f3b42295ee35bb97c426d6b5d to 7ebe3eb93b4a8cca6aca6e8af5bc3673fa140666 are granted.

justifications.durability: tests/test_route_before_queue.py:307-308 fails when queued admission reverts to deterministic routing, as repair-negative-control.log demonstrates, but it does not exercise an explicit queued move.
justifications.evidence: repair-base.log and repair-head-final.log record complete 9-pass and 10-pass route gates, while repair-negative-control.log shows the new model assertion failing as sol versus astra.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:237-276 reuses dispatch's picker resolution but omits the existing backend_override destination when choosing whether to replay the pick.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:275 restores the stored model but also lets that pick displace the destination supplied by the queued move path.
justifications.reuse: The capability search found the model resolver in reckon/crew/dispatch_plan.py:214 and its existing direct-pick test in tests/test_a_picked_model_is_the_model_launched.py:180; queue_admission.py:275 extends that owner through queued dispatch.
justifications.scope_discipline: The e342eff679bd6e0f3b42295ee35bb97c426d6b5d..7ebe3eb93b4a8cca6aca6e8af5bc3673fa140666 diff changes only queue_admission.py, tests/test_route_before_queue.py and the declared fragment.
